title: Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogResources
description: A group, an application (service principal) or a SharePoint Online site added to an entitlement management catalog (accessPackageResource, written through accessPackageResourceRequest adminAdd / adminRemove). Found by the tuple (catalogId, originId), a site URL compared case-insensitively and without its trailing slash; the GUID name is a label.

catalogId.description: Required: the catalog's object id, for example [reference('catalog').id].

originId.description: Required: the group's object id ([reference('group').id]); for AadApplication the service principal's object id ([reference('sp').id]); for SharePointOnline the site URL (https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Example).

originSystem.description: AadGroup (the default), AadApplication (an enterprise application: originId is its service principal) or SharePointOnline (a site: originId is its URL).

permissions.notes: Learn (entitlementmanagement-post-resourcerequests, entitlement-management-delegate, groups-concept): EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged permission, plus a permission on the resource for an application caller: Group.ReadWrite.All for a group, Application.ReadWrite.All for an application (AadApplication), Sites.FullControl.All for a site (SharePointOnline); the provider asks for the one of the declared originSystem, all three when it is computed. A group: the caller must be a catalog owner or Identity Governance Administrator AND an owner of the group or hold a role that changes its members; a role-assignable group can only be added by a Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator (or an owner of the group), and an application then needs RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory too. An application: Identity Governance Administrator alone may add it, or a catalog owner who owns the application or is an Application Administrator / Cloud Application Administrator. A site: a catalog owner or Identity Governance Administrator who is also a SharePoint Administrator or an administrator of the site; Graph lists sites in a catalog only to delegated callers. Without them Graph answers 403 (CatalogResourceAccessDenied). rolesAllOf: the roles are needed together (a catalog owner role AND a role that changes the group); the permission manifest narrows the second part to Privileged Role Administrator for a role-assignable template group and drops it for any other template group. rolesAllOfByValue replaces rolesAllOf for a literal originSystem of an application or a site.
